The core implementation is in `binding/form_mapping.go`, which contains the generic mapping machinery (`mapping`, `tryToSetValue`, `setByForm`, `setWithProperType`, `trySplit`, `setSlice`, `setArray`) that copies request parameters onto struct members by tag name with default/fallback handling and delimiter-splitting of lists.

`binding/form_mapping.go`
`binding/form.go`
`binding/query.go`
`binding/uri.go`
`binding/header.go`

The first file implements the tag-driven reflection mapping, fallback `default` values, and `collection_format` delimiter splitting; the other four invoke that machinery for specific request sources (form/multipart, query, URI, and headers).

`binding/form_mapping.go` — the `mapFormByTag`/`mapping`/`tryToSetValue`/`setByForm` chain walks struct fields, reads the configured tag (e.g. `form`/`uri`/`header`), falls back to the field name when the tag is empty, applies `default=...` options, and splits list values on the `collection_format` delimiter (`csv`/`ssv`/`tsv`/`pipes`) before assigning to slices/arrays.
`binding/header.go` — header binding reuses the same `setByForm` machinery via a `headerSource` setter, so tag-name lookup, defaults, and delimiter splitting are shared rather than reimplemented.
`binding/query.go` — query binding feeds `req.URL.Query()` into `mapForm`/`mapFormByTag`, the same tag-driven mapping entry point.
`binding/form.go` — the form binding entry point that converts the multipart form into `map[string][]string` and passes it to `mapForm`.
`binding/binding.go` — declares the `Binding`/`BindingUri` interfaces (`BindUri(map[string][]string, any)`) that the tag-based mappers implement.

`binding/form_mapping.go` is the file that implements exactly this: it walks struct fields via reflection, reads the tag name (falling back to the field name when the tag is empty), parses a `default=` option for fallback values, and splits list values on a delimiter chosen by the `collection_format` tag (`csv`/`ssv`/`tsv`/`pipes`, or `multi` for no splitting) in `trySplit`.

`binding/header.go` and `binding/form.go` reuse the same `setter`/`setByForm` machinery for header and form binding, and `binding/query.go` binds query params through the same path — so they're the next most relevant, but `form_mapping.go` is where the tag-name/fallback/delimiter logic actually lives.

```
binding/form_mapping.go
binding/header.go
binding/form.go
binding/query.go
context.go
```

`binding/form_mapping.go` — contains the core `mapFormByTag`/`mapping` traversal, `tryToSetValue` (tag-name lookup with field-name fallback and `default=` fallback values), `trySplit` (splits list values on the `collection_format` delimiter), and `setByForm` which applies them. `binding/form.go` — the `formBinding` entry point that parses the request and calls `mapForm`. `binding/query.go` — the `queryBinding` entry point that feeds URL query values into the same mapping. `binding/uri.go` — the `uriBinding` entry point that feeds route params into the same mapping. `binding/header.go` — the `headerBinding` entry point that feeds request headers into the same mapping.
